sentences.en: She is in the third trimester of her pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 她怀孕已经进入了第三个月期。

sentences.en: Typically, human pregnancy is divided into three trimesters of approximately three months each.
sentences.zh: 通常，人类妊娠会被分为三个约三个月的学期。

sentences.en: The school year is split into three trimesters.
